'''''Night''''' can refer to the following:

==Books and chapters==
* ''[[Towers of Midnight]]'' - the thirteenth book of ''[[The Wheel of Time]]'' series.
* ''[[The Eye of the World/Chapter 5|Winternight]]'' - the fifth chapter of ''[[The Eye of the World]]''.
* ''[[The Great Hunt/Chapter 27|The Shadow in the Night]]'' - the twenty-seventh chapter of ''[[The Great Hunt]]''.
* ''[[The Dragon Reborn/Chapter 5|Nightmares Walking]]'' - the fifth chapter of ''[[The Dragon Reborn]]''.
* ''[[The Dragon Reborn/Chapter 36|Daughter of the Night]]'' - the thirty-sixth chapter of ''The Dragon Reborn''.
* ''[[The Dragon Reborn/Chapter 40|A Hero in the Night]]'' - the fortieth chapter of ''The Dragon Reborn''.
* ''[[The Fires of Heaven/Chapter 22|Birdcalls by Night]]'' - the twenty-second chapter of ''[[The Fires of Heaven]]''.
* ''[[Lord of Chaos/Chapter 14|Dreams and Nightmares]]'' - the fourteenth chapter of ''[[Lord of Chaos]]''.
* ''[[A Crown of Swords/Chapter 21|Swovan Night]]'' - the twenty-first chapter of ''[[A Crown of Swords]]''.
* ''[[Crossroads of Twilight/Chapter 20|In the Night]]'' - the twentieth chapter of ''[[Crossroads of Twilight]]''.
* ''[[The Gathering Storm/Chapter 4|Nightfall]]'' - the fourth chapter of ''[[The Gathering Storm]]''.
* ''[[The Gathering Storm/Chapter 28|Night in Hinderstap]]'' - the twenty-eighth chapter of ''The Gathering Storm''.

==Others==
* ''[[Annals of the Final Night]]'' - a book by [[Marsim]] of [[Manetheren]].
* [[Armies of Night]] - a name for [[Luthair Paendrag Mondwin]]'s army.
* ''[[Cor Darei]]'' - an [[Aiel]] [[Aiel warrior society|warrior society]] whose name means "Night Spears" in the [[Old Tongue]].
* ''cor'' and ''fear'' - two words in the Old Tongue that mean "night."
* [[Lanfear]] - in the Old Tongue "Daughter of the Night."
* [[Nightlily]] - a [[horse]] owned by [[Nemaris]]
* [[Shepherd of the Night]] - a name for the Dark One.
* [[Swovan Night]] - a [[:Category:Holidays|holiday]] on [[Taisham 14]].
* [[The Towers of Midnight]] - a fortress complex of thirteen towers in [[Imfaral]].
* [[Winternight]] - a holiday marking the last day of winter.
